tldr: Moon in the 7th house: emotional needs becomes personal through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
body:
With the Moon in the 7th house, this part of you responds through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict. The Moon describes emotional needs, instinct, memory, care, and the search for safety. In practice, this brings attention to the one-to-one dynamics that show you how you meet others and how you let yourself be met.

When this placement is supported, relationship patterns can become clearer while there is still room to choose differently. The Moon can become emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and care that knows where it needs to go.

When it is strained, you may hand too much power to the other person or make them carry the whole story. The harder pattern can show up as mood-driven choices, defensiveness, or letting old needs run the present.
gift: emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and care that knows where it needs to go expressed through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
challenge: mood-driven choices, defensiveness, or letting old needs run the present around partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
